description: This file contains conversion functions between different note data models, including converting NextcloudNote to SyncNote, SyncNote to Note, updating existing notes, and creating IdMapping objects. It facilitates data synchronization between local and remote representations in the app.

methods.name: asSyncNote
methods.description: Converts a NextcloudNote to a SyncNote for synchronization purposes.

methods.name: toLocalNote
methods.description: Converts a SyncNote into a local Note object, with options for default pinned status.

methods.name: updateLocalNote
methods.description: Updates an existing local Note with data from a SyncNote.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Creates an IdMapping object associating local and remote note IDs for synchronization.
